items.title: BlockStrap: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: A critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. The most critical issue is CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap).

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: A zero-day template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in Magento and Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code and has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) to address this flaw.

items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released an urgent security update to resolve a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations. This vulnerability has been exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and several incorrect authorization flaws, which could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical Incorrect Authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated customer account takeover. This vulnerability was fixed in APSB26-92 and added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could result in privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Improper Encoding
items.summary: A critical RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source is caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction. This flaw is network-exploitable and requires no authentication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses a critical RCE vulnerability (CVE-2026-48358) in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, which could lead to full storefront compromise.
